channel: el-testing/_threads/Deposit testing with higher gas limits
searchText: <@412614104222531604> <@808969530608451584> need to make sure that the tx have highest priority fee and ideally also get sent to the mempool at the same time to be included in a single payload, although you can sent much more than 8192 to make sure we can fill a block, also this requires batching to work with 193M gas looks like having 8200 deposits in a single block effectively kills the network right now what gas limit is this at? 200M 410 deposits fit into a 10M gas tx. scale it up ; this is the spamoor config that breaks a 200M network with 8200 deposits / block: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethpandaops/spamoor/refs/heads/master/spammer-configs/deposit-contract-batch.yaml` (import via the UI and run either the top up or new deposit spammer, it's configured to send 20x10M gas txs with 410 deposits each) the sweet spot with the batching contract is at ~193.4M can you toss the full config in diamond as a new scenario too please? 😄 so 200M gas is effectively unsafe as of now we gonna need to either increase this limit or have a proper error handling somehow to not allow such overflow do you have an error log, I suspect it's failing the ssz serialization? lighthouse throws: ``` May 05 17:43:17.600 WARN Execution engine call failed error: BadResponse("Failed to convert json to execution requests: DecodeError(\"Failed to decode DepositRequest from EL: BytesInvalid(\\\"VariableList of 12300 items exceeds maximum of 8192\\\")\")") May 05 17:43:17.600 WARN Error processing HTTP API request elapsed_ms: 298.338394, status: 400 Bad Request, path: /eth/v3/validator/blocks/40, method: GET ``` geth doesn't show a explicit error, but that'S kinda expected, no? I think el clients must keep track of the number of deposits when building blocks, so they skip deposits when the limit is reached yes, this breaks liveness, same error will happen with any CL client and the EL is completely unaware and keeps building these invalid payloads, we need to fix this one way or the other, either increase CL limit further or have the EL limit the amount of deposit txs they pack per payload. This is not very likely to happen in practice but a wealthy attacker (eg. nation state) could abuse this. Also worth pointing out we should not rely on builders "to safe us" here because an attacker could also trigger the circuit breaker at the same time.
